name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Deliver: Push link coverage toward 100% at +5%/day (the access gate)

name: Reel
text: Use the kimtaeyoon83/mcp-server-youtube-transcript tool on all 10 pending videos today. It’s the only open-source option that gives us clean JSON with timestamps, speaker IDs, and raw text—no extra formatting, no paywall. The trade-off is speed: it’s slower than Kaedim’s paid API, but we hit 100% coverage faster than waiting for approvals.

name: Scriv
text: The real risk is that kimtaeyoon83/mcp-server-youtube-transcript isn’t maintained—last commit was 8 months ago, and YouTube’s API changes break scrapers monthly. A better alternative is to fork and patch the tool in-house while running Kaedim’s paid API in parallel for critical videos; settle the argument by testing both on the next 3 videos and comparing output quality and speed.
